def solve(gi):
    g=[row[:] for row in gi]
    # iteratively: zero cells adopt value of nearest nonzero strictly up-right OR up-left, preferring closer
    changed=True
    while changed:
        changed=False
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(W):
                if g[r][c]!=0: continue
                opts=[]
                for dr,dc in [(-1,-1),(-1,1)]:
                    rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                    if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and gi[rr][cc]!=0:
                        opts.append((gi[rr][cc],abs(dr)+abs(dc)))
                opts.sort(key=lambda x:x[1])

def solve(gi):
    Hh,Ww=len(gi),len(gi[0]); g=[row[:] for row in gi]
    for _ in range(Hh+Ww):  # iterate to fill holes chained from filled cells
        changed=False
        for r in range(Hh):
            for c in range(Ww):
                if g[r][c]!=0: continue
                vals=[]
                rr,cc=r-1,c+1  # up-right
                while 0<=rr<Hh and 0<=cc<Ww and g[rr][cc]==0:
                    vals.append((g[rr][cc],None)) ; rr-=1; cc+=1
                if 0<=rr<Hh and 0<=cc<Ww: vals.append((g[rr][cc],'ur')); rr=None
                else: vals.append((-1,'b'))
                rl,cl=r+1,c-1  # down-left
                while 0<=rl<Hh and 0<=cl<Ww and g[rl][cl]==0: rl+=1; cl-=1
                if 0<=rl<Hh and 0<=cl<Ww: vals.append((g[rl][cl],'dl'))
                else: vals.append((-1,'b'))
                nz=[v for v,_ in vals if v>=0]
                if len(nz)==1: g[r][c]=nz[0]; changed=True
                elif len(nz)>1: g[r][c]=min(nz)  # tie-break unknown; try min later
        if not changed: break
    return g
